verdict.rationale: GitLab docs show relevant governance capabilities—compliance controls with audit-ready evidence per pipeline, consolidated security scanning (SAST/SCA/Secret Detection/DAST) surfaced in MRs, and CI/CD process management across multiple projects via API—which support enforcing standards and policies across teams. However, evidence lacks detail on specific policy-enforcement mechanisms like merge request approval rules, push rules, compliance frameworks/pipelines, or protected branch policies that would directly demonstrate cross-repo standardization, and no independent/hands-on corroboration confirms these work at scale. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of compliance pipelines/frameworks, merge request approval policies, protected branches/push rules enforcement, and independent verification of policy enforcement across many teams.
